name: PR list FINDINGS column opens the findings popover
description: On the seeded repo's PR list, PR #482's FINDINGS cell shows a per-severity breakdown of its latest review (seed: 1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING, so two badges and no SUGGESTION badge). Clicking a badge must open the findings popover — headed '2 findings' and listing the seeded finding — WITHOUT navigating to the PR detail route, which the whole row's onClick would otherwise do. That non-navigation is the point of the flow: the popover panel is portalled out of the table card (which sets overflow:hidden), so this also proves the panel is not clipped. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run via ../scripts/e2e.sh.
